objective: Verify actual Codex CLI skill discovery and explicit invocation.
scenario: A human installs the adapter in a real Codex workspace and tests `/skills` plus `$peanuts` in an authenticated Codex session.
expected_behaviors: Explicit $peanuts invocation loads the intended skill.
Codex reads AGENTS.md and relevant references.
Tool availability and permission prompts are reported accurately.
prohibited_behaviors: Infer runtime success from package validation.
Claim discovery without inspecting the actual Codex session.
